id: COST1: cost of recovery of the final controller - what holding in place saves against stepping (stepping baseline, learned policy), including hand loads
registered: 2026-11-05, before any COST1 run on the registered seeds. Purpose: earlier cost results (HF8, HFMF, HFDF) were on earlier controller versions and against FALCON only; the paper needs them on the final controller and against the stepping baseline. Dev evidence: one smoke run each at x+50 N, seed 1300, used only to check the pipeline. Thresholds are taken from HF8 unchanged.

arms.OURS: final controller LCMHF, exactly as HFFINAL (run_hffinal.sh)
arms.FALCON: original policy unchanged, as HFFINAL; push conditions only (no hand-load conditions)

conditions.A holdable (10 conditions, primary): 0.2 s impulse: x and y +-30 N, x and y +-50 N, xy +-50 N
conditions.B step-needed (4, reported): 0.2 s impulse: x and y +-70 N
conditions.C variable load (8, OURS and B11): hand load 0.5, 1, 2 kg from 1 s with x+50 N or y-50 N at 3 s; load schedule 1:2, 4:0, 5.5:1 kg (pick, place, re-grasp) with x+50 N or y-50 N at 3 s and y-50 N at 7 s

metrics.window: 2.9-6.0 s for all costs, same as HF8; the load schedule's second push at 7 s is outside the window and counts only for recovery and steps
metrics.displacement: horizontal base displacement between window ends (m)
metrics.peak foot force: maximum foot normal force in the window (N)
metrics.leg work: sum |tau v| dt over the 12 leg joints in the window (J)
metrics.heat proxy: mean sum tau^2 over the 12 leg joints in the window (N^2 m^2), proportional to copper loss only for equal torque constants
metrics.steps: contact_steps.py over the whole run, all arms

analysis: paired on condition and seed, costs on runs recovered by both arms; median paired reduction 1 - ours/other; one-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank unless stated. Recoveries of each arm are always reported next to the costs because costs are conditional on recovery by both.

predictions.C1 vs B11, group A: displacement reduction >= 50 %, peak foot force >= 15 %, leg work >= 25 %, each p < 0.01
predictions.C2 vs FALCON, group A: the same three thresholds (HF8 D1-D3 on the final controller)
predictions.C3 variable load vs B11, group C: recoveries OURS >= B11 - 2 of 48 and steps OURS <= 0.8 x B11; costs reported with the tests above
predictions.heat proxy (no prediction): reported with two-sided Wilcoxon in A, B and C; earlier results showed no reduction, so no energy claim beyond what is measured

reported: group B costs and recoveries; per-condition table; quiet-stance heat proxy and leg work in 1.0-2.9 s per arm
runs: A + B: 14 conditions x 6 seeds x 3 arms = 252; C: 8 x 6 x 2 = 96; total 348
